angle: Undercharging may be less about being modest and more about avoiding rejection.
audience_problem: An experienced expert keeps their prices lower than they want because naming a higher price feels emotionally unsafe.
audience_desire: Charge appropriately without guilt, shame, or fear of rejection.
hook_direction: Expose the hidden reason an expert keeps lowering their price.
why_now: Pricing is often treated as a sales-skill problem while the emotional reason behind undercharging is ignored.
